excerpt: The Edgemont Cove is a curved outdoor kitchen from Range with a grill, a griddle and a pizza oven all built into the run.
description:
The Edgemont Cove is Range's curved outdoor kitchen, and the curve is the point: the run wraps rather than sitting flat against a wall, so the cook faces the space instead of turning their back on it.
Three appliances are built in rather than dropped in later, a grill, a griddle and a pizza oven, which is what separates this configuration from the Edgemont Bay layouts in the same range. It is the largest outdoor kitchen Home24Care lists.
This listing arrives with less published detail than the rest of the range. If you need dimensions, appliance specifications or the cabinet finish before committing, contact us and we will get them from the manufacturer before you order.

excerpt: A left-exit spiral tube slide from Backyard Discovery, sized for a 5 foot deck height and sold as an add-on rather than a complete set.
description:
A spiral tube slide built for decks at 5 feet, exiting to the left. Backyard Discovery also lists the right-exit version, so the one to order depends on which side of the tower has room for a child to land and walk away.
This is an add-on part, not a play set. It attaches to a deck you already have and does not come with a frame, so check the deck height is genuinely 5 feet before ordering.

excerpt: A right-exit spiral tube slide from Backyard Discovery, built for a 5 foot deck height and sold on its own as an add-on part.
description:
Backyard Discovery's spiral tube slide in the right-exit configuration, for decks at 5 feet. Exit direction is the only difference between this and the left-exit version, and it comes down to which side of your tower has clear ground at the bottom.
Sold on its own as an add-on. There is no frame in the box, so it is a part for an existing structure rather than a play set in itself.

excerpt: A ten-foot wave slide from Backyard Discovery, sold on its own as a replacement or an addition to a play set you already have.
description:
A ten-foot wave slide from Backyard Discovery, the wave being the dip and rise along its length rather than a straight drop.
It is sold on its own, which makes it a replacement for a slide that has worn out or a way to add one to a structure that can take it. No frame or hardware for building a tower comes with it. Home24Care lists it alongside the gray and yellow versions of the same slide.
